scope: all blobs reachable from every branch, tag and pull-request head on origin (31 commits), including members of ZIP blobs
positive_control: Synthetic (fake) W&B, GitHub, Hugging Face and AWS strings were detected by the patterns; the env-var form of a W&B key is caught by hex40_near_wandb.
limitations: Pattern scan: a negative result does not prove that no credential was ever exposed.
Not scanned: Google Drive files, Colab notebook outputs outside Git, W&B run files, other team members' local copies.
Revocation of the previously exposed W&B key is not established by any scan; the key owner must revoke it in W&B settings.
